tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Read-only. Live availability for one Bookd property and dates (re-reads the owner's calendars first; nothing is booked or held), with room/unit prices, totals including any cleaning fee and taxes, cancellation policy and any deposit due.

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Read-only. Status of a Bookd booking by its booking_id (e.g. BKD-AB12CD3): requested, accepted (= confirmed, including instant bookings), declined, expired or cancelled, with dates, room and price. Returns no guest personal data.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: request_booking, cancel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: request_booking, cancel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
